items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I had Max Roach over there and Art Blakely, when I call the battle of the drums.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Good tenor player, good rhythm section. All I would do is just bring the stars over. I had Max Roach over there and Art Blakely, when I call the battle of the drums.
